additional_context: Current source searches find no `valuws`, no unresolved Resource.id `resoure` typo, and no patient `snipped for brevity` fragment. Later `artefact` wording in `source/resource/resource-notes.xml` was introduced by later resource-identification/versioning work and is separate from the DSTU1 typo locations fixed under FHIR-6061.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The concrete FHIR-6061 typo corrections are already present in current source, and changing later unrelated British-spelling occurrences would be optional editorial churn rather than required reconciliation.
